_comment: A purpose-built simulated internet for this lab's policy rounds, kept to 8 pools so each
cohort's exposure under a policy stays legible (the starter's 25-pool world would blur it).
`vpn` is typed `datacenter` on purpose: that is what makes a blunt 'block datacenter ASNs'
policy visibly catch work-VPN users as collateral, which is Round 2's lesson. Every address
is from a documentation range (RFC 5737 / RFC 3849) and every ASN from the documentation ASN
range (RFC 5398), so none of it can ever point at a real network. The lab's generators read
this file to pick source addresses and ASN/geo; there is no demo_site in this lab.
Rules of engagement: scripts may only use addresses from these pools.
